TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
------------------------
Format: SHP (Shapefile - Vector spatial data)
Total Records: 6,656,497 buildings
CRS: Not specified on portal (typically EPSG:5179 or EPSG:5186 for Korean spatial data)
Recommended Software: ArcGIS, QGIS
Coverage: National (전국)
Filter for this phase: Seoul + Gyeonggi only (do not ingest nationwide into production DB)

DESCRIPTION:
-----------
This dataset integrates building spatial information based on continuous cadastral maps
with building attribute information from the building administration system (Seumter/세움터).
Building-level integrated information combining spatial and registry data.

Usable identity fields (expected in SHP attrs):
- PNU / 고유번호 (19-digit parcel number)
- Geometry: Polygon / MultiPolygon building footprints
